description_en: Having remained buried for many years, Mahādeva Hiti (also known as Sikhucā Hiti) was excavated in 2009 CE (VS 2066) and brought it into the present state.As the Hiti situated next to Mahādeva Mandira (SKH0020) at the Dhũllā Ṭola in Sankhu, it is commonly called Mahādeva Hiti. The Hiti has a stone water conduit which faces east, and a statue of Bhagīratha is set against the wall below the conduit. A four-armed statue of a goddess atop the conduit is unidentifiable, as both of her left hands are broken. Water still flows from the spout but is undrinkable.According to an inscription (SKH0020_I_001)preserved at Mahādeva Mandira (SKH0020),a certain Jayanārāyaṇa (text: Jayanārāyana) who enshrined aśivaliṅga(seeSKH0020-003) at the premises of Mahādeva Mandira (SKH0020) constructed the Hiti in 1653 CE (NS 773). He had also constructed aphalcā, but it is no longer in existence. Although the Hiti was buried for many years, it survived in the memory of the senior citizens. Therefore, local youths unearthed it by excavating the site on the occasion of the Sankhu Festival held in 2009 CE (VS 2066).After the Hiti was recovered, local youths cleaned its premises once onSithiNakhaḥ, a minor festival observed on the 6thof the bright fortnight of Jyeṣṭha, for a few years. The annual cleaning of the Hiti premises has been discontinued and the site has remained neglected at present (April 2022).
description_ne: वर्षौंसम्म जमीनमुनि पुरिएर रहेको यस हितिलाई स्थानीयहरूले विसं २०६६ (सन् २००९) मा उत्खनन् गरेर वर्तमान अवस्थामा ल्याएका थिए ।साँखुको धुँल्ला टोलमा रहेको महादेव मन्दिर (SKH0020) सँगै रहेको हिति हुनाले यसलाई महादेव हिति भनिएको हो । स्थानीयहरू यसलाई सिखुचा हिति पनि भन्छन् । यहाँ पूर्वाभिमुख गरी एउटा टुटी बनाइएको छ । टुटीमुनि भगीरथको मूर्ति स्थापना गरिएको छ भने टुटीमाथि कुनै देवीको मूर्ति स्थापना गरिएको छ । देवीको बायाँपट्टिको दुबै हात भाँचिएको छ । हितिमा अहिलेसम्म पानी प्रवाह भइरहे पनि खानयोग्य भने छैन ।यो हिति नेसं ७७३ (सन् १६५३) मा जयनारायन (जयनारायण) नामक व्यक्तिले निर्माण गरेका थिए । उनले महादेव मन्दिर परिसरमा शिवलिङ्ग (SKH0020-003) स्थापना गर्दा फल्चा र यो हिति पनि निर्माण गरेका थिए । शिवलिङ्ग र हिति अहिलेसम्म अस्तित्वमा रहेपनि फल्चा चाहिँ लोप भइसकेको छ । यो हिति पनि पुरिसकिएको थियो । बूढापाकाहरूबाट त्यस ठाउँमा हिति थियो भन्ने कुरा थाहा पाएपछि स्थानीय युवाहरूले साँखु महोत्सवको अवसर पारेर विसं २०६६ (सन् २००९) मा उत्खनन् गरी हितिलाई पुन: अस्तित्वमा ल्याएका थिए ।उत्खनन् गरेर हिति अस्तित्वमा ल्याइसकेपछि केही वर्षसम्म युवाहरूले सिथिनख:को अवसरमा सरसफाइ गरेका थिए । तर अहिले सरसफाइ गर्ने कार्य पनि बन्द भइसकेको छ । अहिले यो हिति बेवारिसे अवस्थामा रहेको छ ।
monument_assessment: Heavily damaged (collapsed, demolished, major cracks and structural damages)

historical_events.event_description: Jayanārāyaṇa (text: Jayanārāyana) constructed the Hiti along with aphalcāwhile establishing aśivaliṅga(SKH0020-003) at Mahādeva Mandira (see the description above for more information).
Local youths unearthed the Hiti by excavating the site where their seniors recalled seeing the water spout (see the description above for more information).
